proposedQlCandidates.name: General figure or symbol mirror image
proposedQlCandidates.learnerMethod: Reflect the complete composition across a vertical mirror axis and preserve all relative geometry.
proposedQlCandidates.examAsk: Choose the exact left-right reflected figure.

proposedQlCandidates.name: Alphanumeric vector-string mirror image
proposedQlCandidates.learnerMethod: Reverse element order and mirror each validated glyph or digit shape.
proposedQlCandidates.examAsk: Choose the mirror image of a letter/digit string.

proposedQlCandidates.name: Analog clock mirror diagram
proposedQlCandidates.learnerMethod: Reflect the full dial and hand geometry; do not convert the task into numeric mirror-time arithmetic.
proposedQlCandidates.examAsk: Choose the reflected analog-clock diagram.
proposedQlCandidates.notes: Numeric mirror-time arithmetic remains owned by CLK-001.

proposedQlCandidates.name: General figure or symbol water image
proposedQlCandidates.learnerMethod: Reflect the complete composition across a horizontal water axis while preserving left-right order.
proposedQlCandidates.examAsk: Choose the exact top-bottom reflected figure.

proposedQlCandidates.name: Alphanumeric vector-string water image
proposedQlCandidates.learnerMethod: Preserve element order and vertically reflect each validated glyph or digit shape.
proposedQlCandidates.examAsk: Choose the water image of a letter/digit string.

proposedQlCandidates.name: Whole-figure rigid transformation analogy
proposedQlCandidates.learnerMethod: Infer one global rotation or reflection and apply it to the second pair.
proposedQlCandidates.examAsk: Complete A→B :: C→? using the same whole-figure transform.
proposedQlCandidates.notes: Rotation angle/direction and reflection axis are parameters, not separate QLs.

proposedQlCandidates.name: Independent component transformation analogy
proposedQlCandidates.learnerMethod: Track components separately and apply orientation change to each rather than the whole figure.
proposedQlCandidates.examAsk: Complete an analogy in which different parts rotate or invert independently.

proposedQlCandidates.name: Component movement or cyclic permutation analogy
proposedQlCandidates.learnerMethod: Track component identity and move one or more components through a positional cycle.
proposedQlCandidates.examAsk: Complete an analogy based on movement or permutation of parts.

proposedQlCandidates.name: Element count change analogy
proposedQlCandidates.learnerMethod: Compare element counts and apply the same addition or removal delta.
proposedQlCandidates.examAsk: Complete an analogy by adding or deleting elements.

proposedQlCandidates.name: Shape or symbol substitution analogy
proposedQlCandidates.learnerMethod: Identify which component identity is replaced while other relations remain invariant.
proposedQlCandidates.examAsk: Complete an analogy using element replacement or substitution.

proposedQlCandidates.name: Nesting, size and containment-state analogy
proposedQlCandidates.learnerMethod: Track inside/outside, hierarchy, relative size and nesting state rather than only orientation.
proposedQlCandidates.examAsk: Complete an analogy based on exchange, enlargement/reduction or containment/intersection state.

proposedQlCandidates.name: Shading or visual-state analogy
proposedQlCandidates.learnerMethod: Track fill or shading state as the decisive changing attribute while geometry remains controlled.
proposedQlCandidates.examAsk: Complete an analogy using shading/fill inversion or transfer.

proposedQlCandidates.name: Compound multi-operation analogy
proposedQlCandidates.learnerMethod: Infer and apply an ordered pipeline of two or more transformations without omitting a step.
proposedQlCandidates.examAsk: Complete an analogy requiring multiple simultaneous or sequential changes.

proposedQlCandidates.name: Transform-equivalence classification
proposedQlCandidates.learnerMethod: Test whether figures are equivalent under an allowed rigid transform and identify the non-equivalent option.
proposedQlCandidates.examAsk: Select the figure that cannot be obtained from the common figure by rotation or reflection.

proposedQlCandidates.name: Symmetry-property classification
proposedQlCandidates.learnerMethod: Test intrinsic vertical, horizontal, 90° or 180° symmetry or invariance.
proposedQlCandidates.examAsk: Select the figure that differs in symmetry property.

proposedQlCandidates.name: Geometric form and closure classification
proposedQlCandidates.learnerMethod: Inspect intrinsic figure form such as polygon class, side parity, straight-sidedness, openness or closure.
proposedQlCandidates.examAsk: Select the figure that breaks the common intrinsic geometric or closure property.
proposedQlCandidates.notes: Geometry and closure merge because both are unary intrinsic-form checks rather than relations between components.

proposedQlCandidates.name: Count-relation classification
proposedQlCandidates.learnerMethod: Compare counts across dots, sides, lines or symbol classes and test the same relation in each option.
proposedQlCandidates.examAsk: Select the figure that breaks the common count relation.

proposedQlCandidates.name: Nested, replica and relative-size relation classification
proposedQlCandidates.learnerMethod: Compare hierarchy, replica identity and relative size between nested components.
proposedQlCandidates.examAsk: Select the figure that breaks the common nesting, replica or size relation.

proposedQlCandidates.name: Relative-position and orientation relation classification
proposedQlCandidates.learnerMethod: Track same, opposite, diagonal and toward-away relations among specified components.
proposedQlCandidates.examAsk: Select the figure that breaks the common positional or orientation relation.

proposedQlCandidates.name: Topology and connectivity classification
proposedQlCandidates.learnerMethod: Inspect branch points, true crossings, terminal counts and connectivity structure.
proposedQlCandidates.examAsk: Select the figure that differs in topology or connectivity.

proposedQlCandidates.name: Shading, fill and partition-state classification
proposedQlCandidates.learnerMethod: Compare amount and location of fill and partition state while ignoring irrelevant orientation differences.
proposedQlCandidates.examAsk: Select the figure that breaks the common shading, fill or partition property.

proposedQlCandidates.name: Intra-option mirror, water or rotation relation classification
proposedQlCandidates.learnerMethod: Compare paired subfigures inside each option and identify which pair uses a different transform relation.
proposedQlCandidates.examAsk: Select the option whose internal pair is not related by the common mirror, water or rotation rule.
proposedQlCandidates.notes: Scale passed 200 accepted from 351 attempts with 151 canonical duplicates; retain as one narrow QL candidate, not multiple transform-specific QLs.

proposedQlCandidates.name: Whole-figure transformation series
proposedQlCandidates.learnerMethod: Infer a repeated whole-figure rotation, reflection or inversion and apply the next transform step.
proposedQlCandidates.examAsk: Select the next figure in a global transformation sequence.
proposedQlCandidates.notes: Rotation angle/direction and reflection axis are parameters.

proposedQlCandidates.name: Independent component transformation series
proposedQlCandidates.learnerMethod: Track orientation changes of multiple components independently across frames.
proposedQlCandidates.examAsk: Select the next figure when components rotate or invert by different rules.

proposedQlCandidates.name: Positional movement and cyclic permutation series
proposedQlCandidates.learnerMethod: Track component identity through repeated position shifts or cyclic reorderings.
proposedQlCandidates.examAsk: Select the next figure in a movement or permutation sequence.
proposedQlCandidates.notes: Single marker or dot movement and multi-element permutation merge because both use positional tracking.

proposedQlCandidates.name: Count, addition and removal progression
proposedQlCandidates.learnerMethod: Infer the numerical element-count delta or add/remove schedule across frames.
proposedQlCandidates.examAsk: Select the next figure using a count progression.

proposedQlCandidates.name: Shading and fill progression
proposedQlCandidates.learnerMethod: Track which component or region changes fill state and infer the repeated fill progression.
proposedQlCandidates.examAsk: Select the next figure in a shading or fill sequence.

proposedQlCandidates.name: Substitution and replacement progression
proposedQlCandidates.learnerMethod: Track element identity changes and infer the repeated replacement cycle.
proposedQlCandidates.examAsk: Select the next figure in a substitution or replacement sequence.

proposedQlCandidates.name: Alternating-operation series
proposedQlCandidates.learnerMethod: Identify an ABAB or phased schedule in which different operations alternate by step.
proposedQlCandidates.examAsk: Select the next figure by continuing the alternating operation schedule.

proposedQlCandidates.name: Compound multi-rule series
proposedQlCandidates.learnerMethod: Track two or more simultaneous rules and apply all of them to obtain the next frame.
proposedQlCandidates.examAsk: Select the next figure in a multi-rule compound series.

holds.name: Analog clock water-image diagram
holds.reason: Retain DIAGRAM_ONLY hold until exam-priority and numeric-interpretation boundary are explicitly settled.

holds.name: Letter or symbol identity-set replacement oddity
holds.reason: Requires separate glyph/symbol authority and exam-priority decision; do not mix semantic symbol classification into geometric FCL.
